name: cape_town_generality
query:
What port charges does the vessel SUDESTADA have to pay for her call at Cape Town?
Vessel: SUDESTADA, bulk carrier, built 2010, flag Malta.
Gross tonnage 51,300. Net tonnage 31,192. DWT 93,274. Length overall 229.2 m. Beam 38.0 m.
Arrived 2024-11-15 10:12, departed 2024-11-22 13:00, 3.39 days alongside.
Activity: exporting iron ore, 40,000 t, 2 cargo operations, 7 holds.
List every charge she owes, with the section and page each rate came from.

args.answer:
For the port call of the bulk carrier SUDESTADA at the Port of Cape Town, the total port charges payable by the vessel amount to ZAR 440,884.93 (excluding VAT).

The charges levied on the vessel comprise:
1. **Light Dues (Section 1.1.1, page 9):** ZAR 60,062.04 based on 513 units of 100 GT at ZAR 117.08 per 100 tons or part thereof.
2. **Vessel Traffic Services (VTS) Charges (Section 2.1.1, page 11):** ZAR 27,702.00 at ZAR 0.54 per GT (51,300 GT).
3. **Pilotage Services (Section 3.3, page 13):** ZAR 23,149.98 for two services (inward and outward), each comprising a basic fee of ZAR 6,342.39 plus ZAR 10.20 per 100 GT or part thereof (513 units).
4. **Tugs / Craft Assistance and Attendance (Section 3.6, page 15):** ZAR 109,186.98 for two services (inward and outward), each consisting of a base charge of ZAR 53,978.33 (for vessels 50,001–100,000 GT) plus ZAR 47.32 per 100 GT or part thereof in excess of 50,000 GT (13 units).
5. **Berthing Services (Section 3.8, page 18):** ZAR 21,412.58 for two services (berthing and unberthing), each comprising a basic fee of ZAR 3,052.33 plus ZAR 14.92 per 100 GT or part thereof (513 units).
6. **Port Dues (Section 4.1.1, page 21):** ZAR 199,371.35, consisting of the basic port dues fee of ZAR 192.73 per 100 GT (ZAR 98,870.49) plus the time-based fee of ZAR 57.79 per 100 GT per 24-hour period pro rata for the stated alongside duration of 3.39 days (ZAR 100,500.86).

Charges not included in this total:
- **Cargo Dues (Section 7.2):** Payable by the cargo owner/shipper on the 40,000 t of iron ore exported, rather than by the vessel.
- **Berth Dues (Section 4.1.2):** Not applicable as the vessel was actively engaged in cargo operations and no unworked berth delay was reported.
- **Running of Vessel Lines (Section 3.9):** Applicable only if a launch or mooring boat was specifically utilized to run mooring lines.
- **SAMSA Levy (Section 1.2):** Prescribed by separate SAMSA Levy Determination Regulations outside this tariff document.
- **Removal of Refuse (Section 4.7):** Fees are quoted upon application.
notes: All tariff rates are subject to Value Added Tax (VAT) at 15%. All amounts reported are exclusive of VAT.
Ordinary working hours at Cape Town for marine services are 24 hours (00:01 to 24:00), hence no overtime surcharges apply to pilotage, tugs, or berthing.
Marine services incentive discounts under Section 3.2 were not applied as no qualifying call threshold (100 dry bulk calls) was indicated.

assumptions: Vessel tonnage is based on 51,300 GT as per the 1969 Tonnage Convention.
Charged at ZAR 117.08 per 100 tons or part thereof (ceil(51,300 / 100) = 513 units of 100 GT).
Light dues are raised at the first South African port of call and valid for up to 60 days in South African waters.
